about.title: About
about.description: About Mewvo, a Discord bot for moderation and community, and who runs it.
about.heading: About Mewvo
about.lead: Mewvo is a Discord bot for moderation and community. It started as the bot of the Mewvo server and can now be added to any server.

started.heading: How it started
started.text: Mewvo began as a fork of TitanBot, an open-source (MIT) Discord bot, and has since been rebuilt around the server’s own needs: an enforcement system with case codes and appeals, a warning ladder, automod, tickets and modmail, and a web dashboard for the staff team.

members.heading: How it treats members
members.list:
- Every punishment comes with a DM that says what happened, why, until when, and whether and how it can be appealed.
- Staff actions are recorded as cases, so decisions can be reviewed and corrected.
- Verification asks Discord only for your identity and permission to add you to the support server, never your email.
- Members can delete their own data from the bot in a server with `/wipedata`.

availability.heading: Availability
availability.public: Mewvo can be added to other servers with the button at the top of the page.
availability.private: For now Mewvo runs only on its own server; it can’t be added to other servers yet.

help.heading: Get help

help.withoutInvite: Ask the staff team on the Mewvo server.
